title: Desk Training Questions: Screened Nights Absorbed on an Assisted Living Respite Stay
content:
**Rule.** On an Assisted Living Respite Stay under the Respite and Short-Term Stay Agreement, the screened nights absorbed, which are the first nights of the stay and stay billed at the screened level, are none (0 nights) for a guest whose active Larkspur independent living residency is at the same community as the stay, one night (1 night) for a guest whose active Larkspur independent living residency is at another community, and two nights (2 nights) for any other guest.

## Questions answered

**What are screened nights absorbed?** They are the first nights of the stay, which stay billed at the screened level, the care level of the stay as screened before arrival.

**Which records decide the number?** The guest's Independent Living Residency Agreement in active status and the Larkspur community of that residency, compared with the community of the stay.

**A guest lives in independent living at Larkspur at Willow Creek and takes a respite stay at Larkspur at Willow Creek. How many nights are absorbed?** None, 0 nights: the active residency is at the same community as the stay.

**The same guest takes the respite stay at Larkspur at Harbor View instead. How many?** One night: the active residency is at another community.

**A guest has no Larkspur independent living residency, or one that is no longer active. How many?** Two nights.

## Summary table

| Guest's active Independent Living Residency Agreement | Community compared with the stay | Screened nights absorbed |
|---|---|---|
| Held | Same community | 0 nights |
| Held | Another community | 1 night |
| Not held | — | 2 nights |
